title: `approveClosure()` marks audit closed without checking open major NCs
description:
Files: `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/audit-assurance/services/audit-closure.service.js:131–170`

Root Cause: `approveClosure()` updates `approveStatus` to approved and transitions the audit to `closed` in a single operation with no pre-condition query against `audit_nonconformances`. The only existing guard checks that the closure checklist is complete — NC disposition is never verified.

Impact: An ISO 27001 Clause 9.2.2 requirement mandates all nonconformities be corrected before an audit can be signed off. An external certification body reviewing this platform's records would immediately flag this as a major NC against the platform itself.

Claude Fix Prompt:
```
Fix CD-001 in vibrantix-backend/src/modules/audit-assurance/services/audit-closure.service.js around lines 131–170.

The approveClosure() method approves audit closure without checking for open major nonconformances.

Required changes:
1. Before the status update, query AuditNonConformance:
     const openMajorNCs = await AuditNonConformance.countDocuments({
       auditId: closure.auditId,
       ncType: 'major',
       status: { $nin: ['closed', 'accepted', 'not_applicable'] }
     });
2. If openMajorNCs > 0, throw 422:
     "Cannot approve closure: ${openMajorNCs} major NC(s) still open. Resolve or formally accept all major NCs before closure."
3. Append an audit trail entry when the gate passes (timestamp, userId, openMajorNCs count checked).
4. Do NOT gate on minor NCs — advisory only.
5. Unit tests: (a) 422 when open major NC exists, (b) approval succeeds when all major NCs closed/accepted.
```

title: Company size selection UI removed — every Quick Template audit silently uses `startup_smb` template regardless of org size
description:
Files: `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/audit-assurance-2/CreateTemplateAuditPage.jsx`

Root Cause: The company size selection step was removed from the Quick Template flow but the template resolver was not updated. The template always resolves to `startup_smb` regardless of actual org size.

Impact: A 10,000-person enterprise gets a startup-sized audit template (~30–40 controls) when ISO 27001 full scope is 93 controls. The audit is fundamentally mis-scoped with no user warning.

Claude Fix Prompt:
```
Fix D-01 in vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/audit-assurance-2/CreateTemplateAuditPage.jsx.

Company size selector was removed so Quick Template always uses startup_smb template.

Option A — Restore company size step:
1. Re-add company size selection: startup_smb (1–50), medium (51–500), enterprise (500+).
2. Wire selected size to the template resolver so the correct templateId is passed to the API.
3. Show the resolved template name in the review step for user confirmation.

Option B — Derive from org profile:
1. Read employeeCount/size from the tenant profile already in the org model.
2. Map ranges: <50 → startup_smb, 51–500 → medium, >500 → enterprise.
3. Show the derived template name with a "Change" override link.

In both cases: never silently default to startup_smb — always make the template selection visible before submission.
```
